title: Per-Customer GPU Seasonality and Buffer Calculator — June 2029
content:
Contract spreadsheet snapshot (human-readable calculation table)

Contract ID,Customer,Primary Region,Reserved GPUs (A100 equiv),Burst Buffer GPUs,Start Date,End Date,Utilization Target %,Seasonality Factor (Q vs Y avg),Effective Alloc (reserved * util * seasonality),Notes
RD-2019,AtlasAI,us-west1,16,4,2029-07-01,2030-06-30,0.75,1.15,16*0.75*1.15=13.8,High Q3 demand; recommend 1.5x burst for training weeks
RD-2034,ClearHealth,eu-west1,8,2,2029-05-15,2030-05-14,0.6,0.95,8*0.6*0.95=4.56,Stable steady state; allow regional burst failover to us-east
RD-2107,Shoply,us-east1,32,8,2029-09-01,2031-08-31,0.85,1.30,32*0.85*1.30=35.36,Seasonal peak Nov-Dec, reserve extra 10% buffer
RD-2176,FinFocus,asia-southeast1,12,6,2029-01-01,2029-12-31,0.5,0.80,12*0.5*0.80=4.8,Regulated workloads; private deployment considered
RD-2220,LearnLabs,us-west2,0,6,2029-10-01,2029-12-31,0.25,1.40,0*0.25*1.40=0.0,Burst-only contract for seasonal training (Oct-Dec)

Summary rows:
Total reserved (sum): 68
Total effective alloc (sum of Effective Alloc): 58.72

Global headroom calculation (planner notes):
- Physical fleet available (projected Oct 2029): 1200 A100-equivalent GPUs
- Committed reserved across contracts (active): 980
- Planned burst baseline (sum of Burst Buffer GPUs): 120
- Projected utilization window peak demand (30-day rolling): 0.78
- Available headroom = physical - (committed * projected utilization) ~ 1200 - (980*0.78) = 1200 - 764.4 = 435.6 -> after burst baseline ~ 315.6

Key caveats:
- Seasonality factor is derived from the customer's last 24 months token consumption and product release calendar; confirm with account team before locking reservations.
- Effective Alloc is a planning metric for capacity planning and scheduling, not a billing metric. Billing follows contract terms and metered usage.
- Burst Buffer is modeled as a transient allowance, not a hard allocation; trigger thresholds are defined in SLA and enforced by routing policy.
- Regional failover increases effective latency and may reduce throughput; ensure customers with strict latency SLAs have pinned regional capacity.

Assumptions and formulas used in this sheet:
- Utilization Target: expected fraction of reserved GPUs used for steady-state inferencing (excludes training spikes).
- Seasonality Factor: ratio of target quarter demand vs annual average (e.g., 1.3 = 30% higher than annual avg).
- Effective Alloc (planning) = Reserved GPUs * Utilization Target * Seasonality Factor. Rounded to two decimals for reporting.
- Burst planning treats Burst Buffer GPUs as multi-tenant transient capacity: assume 40% simultaneous burst at 95th percentile unless contract states otherwise.

Action items (owners and due dates):
- (Aisha) Validate Q4 promotional and release dates with Shoply to confirm seasonality multiplier by 2029-06-23.
- (Ravi) Add private deployment notes and compliance checklist for FinFocus to Infra runbook (file: infra/runbooks/finfocus-private.md) and link to ENG-1210 by 2029-06-21.
- (Elena) Re-run regional failover simulation for ClearHealth with updated egress profiles and report by 2029-06-25.
- (Marcus) Prototype per-contract dynamic scaling policy in staging and link changes to PR #432; include cost telemetry hooks by 2029-06-30.
- (Infra Ops) Run capacity safety check (simulated 10-day promotional spike for Shoply) and report action recommendations by 2029-07-02.

Notes to self (working doc style):
- Consider moving Shoply and AtlasAI high-season workloads to dedicated racks in us-east/us-west to reduce cross-region egress and lower tail latency.
- Revisit seasonality smoothing parameter (currently 3-month moving average) if variance >25% on sample set; potential to adopt exponential smoothing for faster adaptation.
- Mark RD-2176 (FinFocus) as candidate for Private tier due to data residency and compliance; cost/operational impact analysis pending.
- Keep one extra day of buffer for handoffs during major platform releases to avoid automated reallocations colliding with on-call rotations.

Appendix: quick sensitivity checks (text table)
- If projected fleet shrinks by 10% (hardware outage/transfer), available headroom falls from ~315 GPUs to ~195 GPUs; prioritized customers: Shoply, AtlasAI, ClearHealth.
- If Shoply Q4 seasonality goes to 1.6 vs 1.3, additional effective demand = 32*(0.85)*(0.3)=8.16 GPUs -> requires adjusting burst policy or temporary overcommit of ~10 GPUs.

End of snapshot. This is a working planning sheet — update as account information changes.
